test: src/main/git/commitLinesProperty.test.ts > commitFiles with random line selections > commits exactly the selected content and never changes the working file
method: throwaway instrumented copy of the test (runner wrapper counting git spawns by subcommand, phase timers summed across the 4 concurrent batches), run alone with env -u CI -u DM_DESKTOP_PIPE -u DM_SESSION_TOKEN; copy deleted

before.cause: per case: 1 rev-parse HEAD probe + 1 diff in the test's read, again 1 rev-parse probe + 1 diff in commitFiles' re-read, and 1 git apply per file; ~430 git processes, which on Windows cost tens of ms each alone and far more under the full suite's parallel load

after.fix: readWorkingDiff takes headExists (from the status) and skips its rev-parse probe; commitFiles passes it and stages all line patches with one multi-file git apply; the property test passes headExists from its status. Same 80 cases, same seeds, same assertions, same timeout.
